text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Admin time dropped fast.** Reps reclaimed about five hours a week previously spent on CRM updates and follow-up recaps.

**2. Consistency beat brilliance.** Notes weren't perfect, but every call had one. Managers finally saw patterns across deals.

**3. Consent matters.** Customers in regulated industries wanted clear disclosure upfront. Reps who explained it early built more trust, not less.

**4. Adoption followed coaching.** Teams that reviewed summaries in weekly one-on-ones stuck with it. Others quietly stopped.

**5. Accuracy needs a human glance.** Names and numbers occasionally slipped, so we added a 60-second review step.

The tool didn't make reps better sellers. It gave them time to be.

What would you want from an AI note-taker?
